inventory.limitation: Physical line counts, byte hashes and AST structure do not establish semantic review or execution of every line. Different source snapshots and process windows remain separate.

repairs.limits: Native replica selection uses an owned separate PostgreSQL schema, not asynchronous replication or restricted-role RLS enforcement. The first native controller inherited an incorrect source126 label and is excluded, with cleanup confirmed. Replica pool ownership/cache changes, production latency, full deployed RLS/privacy and final-source endurance remain separate.

Native replica routing uses separate PostgreSQL schemas, not asynchronous replication. Disposal remains best effort; complete process-shutdown, simultaneous configuration changes, deployed RLS, production latency and final-source endurance remain separate.
